verdict.rationale: Mailchimp documents one maintained first-party commerce integration: the free Mailchimp for Magento integration syncs customers and order data and supports e-commerce ROI tracking. Connecting your own app or product database is possible only by building against the Marketing API and audience webhooks, not through a turnkey integration, and webhooks require the Standard or Premium plan. Missing for 10: any evidence of first-party Stripe or Shopify integrations, a Segment or other CDP connector, a native product-database connector, and independent corroboration of how well the integrations are maintained.
